name: Legal
description: Ensures legal compliance, manages risk, and protects organizational interests through sound legal counsel

roles.name: Legal Counsel
roles.description: Provides comprehensive legal advice and ensures compliance across all business activities
responsibilities: Provide legal counsel and guidance on business matters
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations
Identify and assess legal risks across operations
Develop and implement legal policies and procedures

roles.name: Contract Specialist
roles.description: Manages contracts and agreements to protect organizational interests
responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate contracts and agreements
Manage vendor relationships and procurement contracts
Ensure contract terms protect organizational interests
Maintain contract lifecycle management and compliance

roles.name: Compliance Officer
roles.description: Ensures regulatory compliance and manages risk across the organization
responsibilities: Monitor regulatory changes and their impact on business
Conduct compliance audits and risk assessments
Provide training on legal and compliance matters

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive legal compliance strategy to ensure adherence to laws and regulations.
Design compliance programs and risk management frameworks based on the legal strategy.
Create contract management processes and templates to support legal compliance.
Finalize the integrated legal strategy with compliance metrics and risk management framework.
